bodyHtml:
Aquasky Pressure Tank 80L Design Change Notice ｜ Aquasky

Aquasky Pressure Tank announces 80L New Design change. The 80L tank has a new version and the dimension comparison table as shows. The 80L design changes from a 3 shell design to 2 shell design and increases the diameter.

There are two major advantages of the new design.

The first advantage is to increase the water storage volume in a large different pressure different due to the two shell design. The air can be fully compressed to increase the water storage volume.

 

The second advantage is to be able to lower the height to avoid a high percentage of shipping damage. The volume of the tank is adjusted accurately to 80L. The larger diameter with a shorter height can reduce the space waste in container shipping. The container can load 15% more than 80L to reduce the total shipping cost by 20%.

 

The new design will start in service at 2021 Sep.
